questions.prompt: What format is a saved .jmx test plan?
questions.explanation: A .jmx is XML, so it can be diffed and kept in Git. It is not compiled, zipped or JSON.

questions.prompt: Which keyboard shortcut toggles an element between enabled and disabled in the GUI?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+T toggles enable/disable. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+R starts the test, and Ctrl+D is not the toggle shortcut.

questions.prompt: Stop ends threads immediately, while Shutdown lets threads finish their current work before stopping.
questions.explanation: Stop interrupts threads straight away; Shutdown is the graceful option and lets in-flight samples complete.

questions.prompt: Where in the GUI do you see warnings and errors from JMeter itself, such as a script error?
options: The log viewer, opened from the warning triangle counter or Options > Log Viewer
questions.explanation: JMeter's own log (also written to jmeter.log) appears in the log viewer. View Results Tree shows samples, and Error % counts failed samples, not script exceptions.

questions.prompt: You want to try the same request with and without a header without deleting anything. What is the cleanest approach?
options: Disable the Header Manager, run, then enable it again
Delete the Header Manager and re-create it later
Move the Header Manager to the Test Plan
Save the plan under a new name for each run
questions.explanation: Disabled elements are skipped at run time but stay in the plan. Deleting and re-creating risks mistakes, moving it changes its scope, and copying files creates duplicates to maintain.

questions.prompt: Which actions are available from the right-click menu on a sampler? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: A sampler can take assertions, post-processors, timers and so on as children, and you can wrap it with Insert Parent. Thread Groups can only be added under the Test Plan.

questions.prompt: A learner clicks Start, the green indicator shows '0/10' threads, and no samples ever appear. The plan has a Thread Group with 10 threads but its only HTTP Request is greyed out. What is wrong?
options: The sampler is disabled, so threads start and end immediately with nothing to run
Start must be pressed twice in GUI mode
Listeners must be enabled before threads can run
The HTTP Request needs a Constant Timer to start
questions.explanation: Greyed elements are disabled and skipped. With no enabled samplers each thread finishes instantly. There is no double-start rule, listeners do not gate execution, and timers are optional.

questions.prompt: Two testers edited the same .jmx in Git and got a merge conflict. What is the most sensible way to reduce this in future?
options: Split the work into separate Test Fragments/files included with Include or Module Controllers, and review .jmx diffs as XML
Store the .jmx as a binary file so Git does not merge it
Only ever edit the plan in a text editor
questions.explanation: Because .jmx is XML, smaller modular files and reviewing diffs keep merges manageable. Treating it as binary loses diffs, hand-editing XML is error-prone, and renaming daily destroys history.
